critical_code_review_comments: worker.py: pytest.ini forbids modification but note test_documentary.py must run with `-p no:xdist -o addopts=` because xdist loadscope splits fixtures across workers and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported into the test env by pytest.ini; documented in context for next agent.

server.py /jobs/{id}/render still allows re-render on status='done' — intended so preview can be replaced with full render, but no lock prevents two concurrent render threads on same job_id if UI double-clicks (mild race; last writer wins).
worker._trim_for_preview uses `ffmpeg -c copy` for mp3 trimming which slices at frame boundary (may over/undershoot by up to ~26ms); acceptable for 60s preview. Fallback to libmp3lame handled.
Editor.jsx clears selectedClipId only via a factory helper — fine, but `job.output_path` referenced in polling (line 104) is dead (backend now uses output_key/download URL); safe to remove.
